issue.description:
**Why.** The fake harness is the keystone of testing ([runtime & operations](<https://github.com/pitchopp/owlshift/blob/main/docs/design/runtime-and-operations.md>), "Testing strategy"): it makes the question loop, crashes and usage limits reproducible without consuming a subscription.

**Scope:**

* Fake harness: a script that writes a prepared `result.json`, with optional delays, failures and usage-limit messages.
* Test tracker: one folder per ticket in the repository ([build plan](<https://github.com/pitchopp/owlshift/blob/main/docs/design/build-plan.md>), "CLI surface").
* A local bare git remote fixture.
* A scenario runner that plays a scenario file end to end.

**Acceptance.** One scenario runs end to end in CI on the three platforms.
issue.title: Build the test harness: fake harness, test tracker, local bare remote, scenario runner
